review:
Oktoberfest is one of Nolimit City's earliest slots: a 5x3 beer-hall game with a light tone and a gentle maths model. Party Spins randomly super-stack one mid-paying symbol across the reels, and the Pretzel Party Spin turns every low card symbol into something better for a single spin.

Stacked wilds on reels 2 and 4 trigger Prost Win-spins, respins in which the two characters toast and a win is assured. Three scatters award ten Bierspins. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility with a 34% hit rate and a 500x cap, so it's the opposite of the studio's modern reputation, and a relaxed demo choice.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
